LanguageData.Crib_Giant.label: giant babies bed
LanguageData.Crib_Giant.description: A bed for laying down a giant baby. It looks simple, but it's just right for a sleepy giant baby. A high quality crib will make a baby happy. Multiple cribs can be placed in a bedroom without turning it into a barracks.
LanguageData.DeathrestVampiricTitanCasket.label: Sarcophagus of the Vampiric Titan
LanguageData.DeathrestVampiricTitanCasket.description: A sarcophagus designed for the periodic slumber of vampiric titans. Enormously massive and alien in appearance, it is nonetheless compatible with existing deathrest support devices. The number of devices that can be connected depends on the user's deathrest capacity, which can be selected and viewed.\n\nOnly giants with the deathrest gene can utilize this sarcophagus.
